stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong Walks Off White Sox for 30th HR — Hits 30-30 Club Again

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong walked off the White Sox last night with HR No. 30. Leadoff HR in the 1st. Walk-off HR in the 10th. Cubs win 7-5 in extras. Back-to-back 30-30 seasons. First Cubs player to ever do it. #Cubs #Crosstown

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: PCA is the 19th player in MLB history with multiple 30-30 seasons. He's also the 7th player to hit a leadoff AND walk-off homer in the same game. Cubs lead NL Wild Card No. 1 at 73-53. MVPETE. #Cubs #ChicagoCubs

research.facts:
Pete Crow-Armstrong 30-30 Walk-Off
**Sources:** FOX Sports, theScore, SI, Chicago Sun-Times, NBC Sports, CBS Sports, MLB.com
**Confirmed facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Date: August 18, 2026 — Crosstown Classic Game 2, Cubs at Wrigley vs White Sox
- Final: Cubs 7, White Sox 5 (10 innings)
- HR #29: Leadoff HR in the first inning
- HR #30: Walk-off HR in the 10th inning (Carson Kelly scored on the walk-off per MLB.com video title)
- 31 stolen bases (confirmed: 30-30 club = 30 HR + 30 SB)
- First Cubs player in history to record consecutive 30-30 seasons
- 19th player in MLB history with multiple 30-30 seasons
- 7th player ever to hit both a leadoff AND walk-off HR in the same game
- Mike Madigan (SI takeaways piece) quoted "MVPETE" angle
- Cubs record: 73-53 after win; White Sox: 65-59
